basic_info.description: Darling Victorian cottage, two units, in a small historic residential row surrounded by upscale modern housing. Delivered vacant. Less than a block to Zuni, Room and Makers art gallery, Muni, and rental bikes. Boba Guys, Martuni's, and Hayes Valley are a short walk. Stupendous secret garden with a gigantic Monkey puzzle tree, palms, a roofed lean-to Spanish hacienda style patio, and lots of other magical improvements possible.  Fresh paint inside and out. Some new appliances. Ready to rent or ideal for an owner-user. Washer/dryer
